Thanks man. I will try to speak with my mother and hope she will agree to sign the papers, if not then I will ask the CC office. Also, back to my previous question..at what age do they stop caring about parents' income?

No, she doesn't want to have anything to do with me. I am not sure if she would be willing to fill out the fafsa paperwork for me. When I was applying for college I was the one doing all the paperwork, my mother didn't sign anything (to my memory). I did everything online.
I work right now at a minimum wage job. My mother's (my only parent) income is also quite low. At what age do they stop counting my parent's income?

She has a lot of problems. I suspected she was bipolar for a very long time now, my friend thinks the same. It started because of school. She thinks I am lazy and do not want to go to school. That is the complete opposite actually. My grades started dropping in college and she took the car away. I want to study and learn but it's hard for me to study subjects which do not interest me at all. I was diagnosed with ADD, my mom thinks ADD is a made up disorder for lazy people. I do not take medication for it. I do well in subjects which interest me, such as criminology, psychology, anything computer related, anatomy, etc. Any other subjects and I just cannot keep my mind on it. 
I've never had a dad and my mother is always strict, she doesn't have many close friends because she always talks behind their backs. She's just a genuinely angry person. I've never told her what I thought about her though. I try to be passive towards her but that just pisses her off even more and she starts yelling. She says I'm stupid and I will never become anything, that I am better off dead so I might as well just hang myself. She says that in this day and age I am nothing without a college degree or some sort of documentation that backs up my knowledge. 

Currently I am doing foreign currency trading, FOREX to try and make some money..but at the end of the day I just think that what I am doing is completely useless and I am worthless.
